sections.voiceover: In October 2026, did Glaucia Bordignon publish a systematic review in the Journal of Bodywork and Movement Therapies?
Except Ryan Chang previously investigated ground reaction forces during gait.

Glaucia Bordignon evaluated lower-limb biomechanical alterations across 294 subjects. Elsevier published the meta-analysis by Glaucia Bordignon on kinetic forces. Precisely 294 subjects participated in the study indexed by ScienceDirect.
Glaucia Bordignon authored the study covering 294 subjects.
